assembly_info.comments:
The Malaria Host-Pathogen Interaction Center (MaHPIC) is a transdisciplinary malaria systems biology research program supported by an NIH/NIAID contract (# HHSN272201200031C; see http://www.systemsbiology.emory.edu). The MaHPIC generates many data types (e.g., genomic, clinical, hematological, parasitological, metabolomics, functional genomics, lipidomics, proteomics, immune response) and mathematical models, to iteratively test and develop hypotheses related to the complex host-parasite dynamics in the course of malaria in non-human primates, and metabolomics data via collaborations with investigators conducting clinical studies in malaria endemic countries, with the overarching goal of better understanding human disease, pathogenesis, and immunity. Curation and maintenance of all data and metadata are the responsibility of the MaHPIC. To access other publicly available MaHPIC results, including clinical and -omics results from MaHPIC experiments, visit http://plasmodb.org/plasmo/mahpic.jsp
Scaffold naming is based on the length of each scaffold in order of shortest to longest.

This is a PacBio-based assembly that was corrected using Illumina HiC. Contigs in scaffolds are connected by gaps represented by runs of 100 N's. PacBio reads belonging to this assembly came from SRA runs SRR5413213- SRR5413218. Illumina HiC reads were deposited in SRA accession SRR5413221. Scaffold naming is based on the length of each scaffold in order of shortest to longest.
The VEuPathDB Bioinformatics Resource Center (www.veupathdb.org) may also have contributed to the annotation of this genome. Annotation and related data can be viewed and updated at http://veupathdb.org and inquiries can be sent to help@veupathdb.org.
